notes.ar: Modern Standard Arabic in Apple's macOS Arabic style: masdar (verbal noun) for buttons and menu items (إضافة، نسخ، جلب), masculine-singular imperative in instructions (اختر، جرّب), headings and section names with the definite article (الفروع، الوسوم). Quotation marks are « » and punctuation is Arabic (، ؛ ؟). Full CLDR plural forms (zero, one, two, few, many, other) with the counted noun's case (tamyiz: 3-10 plural, 11-99 accusative singular, 100+ singular). Keyboard shortcuts, XML tags and code in running Arabic text are wrapped in left-to-right isolates (U+2066 … U+2069) so they keep their order and angle brackets aren't mirrored, and → in menu paths is kept.
notes.de: du-form (informal), as Apple's current macOS German (Dein Mac, Versuche es erneut). Apple's German for the usual things (Sichern, Abbrechen, Im Finder anzeigen, Nach Updates suchen, Weitersuchen, Schlüsselbund, Systemeinstellungen, Programme). A no-break space (U+00A0) goes before … as in Apple's menus (Hinzufügen …). Quotes are „ “. Names of macOS menus are the system's: the File menu is Ablage (Ablage → Zuletzt geöffnet) although a file is Datei. Show/Hide of view elements in menus and the palette is einblenden/ausblenden, in Settings checkboxes and for view modes anzeigen. Commands are infinitives (Datei öffnen), instructions and tooltips du-imperatives (Klicke, Wähle); an em dash becomes a spaced en dash (–) and 100 % keeps a no-break space.
notes.es: Tuteo, as Apple's Spanish does (imperatives like Elige, Añade, Compruébalos; infinitives in tooltips). Apple es (Spain) words for macOS things: Ajustes, Ajustes del Sistema, Aplicaciones, Llavero, Finder, barra lateral, Quitar, Añadir; quoted names in « ». Sentence case. A name of another part of the app is quoted with its exact translation. Toasts are short participle phrases (Imagen copiada, Guardado: nombre). Revert follows Apple (the button is Restaurar, the menu item Volver a la versión guardada), and Zoom In and Zoom Out are Acercar and Alejar.
notes.fr: Vous-form, imperative like Apple (Choisissez, Activez); sentence case, never Title Case. Menu items and buttons take the infinitive (Enregistrer, Ouvrir un dossier…). A no-break space goes before : ; ? ! and % and inside « », as in Vibe GitTree. « ligne » names both a text line and a CSV row.
notes.hi: आप-form with polite imperatives (-ें/-एँ), as in Apple's Hindi; sentences end with '।'. macOS words: टर्मिनल, सेटिंग, सिस्टम सेटिंग, ऐप्लिकेशन, कीचेन, रद्द करें, ठीक, पूर्ण, सहेजें, हटाएँ, ख़ारिज करें. Loanword nouns don't change with the count (5 कमिट, 3 टिकट); only फ़ाइल/फ़ाइलें and दिन में/दिनों में do. 'X of Y' is written X/Y as Apple does. Progress text: 'X किया जा रहा है…'. Developer words are Devanagari loanwords (एडिटर, टैब, लाइन, कॉलम, इंडेंट, एन्कोड, फ़ॉर्मैट), with Apple's native words kept for पूर्वावलोकन, पंक्ति (row), अल्पविराम/अर्धविराम and संपादित करें. A file or folder named by a placeholder takes the default masculine verb ('%@ सहेजा गया'); Latin names, PATH and the vibeNotePad command stay in Latin.
notes.id: Formal 'Anda' (capital A), as Apple's Indonesian software. Everyday words as macOS: berkas (file), folder, tautan (link), bar samping (sidebar), bar alat (toolbar), Rantai Kunci (keychain), Pengaturan (Settings), Pengaturan Sistem (System Settings), Aplikasi, Batalkan, Selesai, Hapus, Salin, Tampilkan di Finder, Buka di Terminal, Temukan (Find). Menus, buttons and titles use Indonesian Title Case with lowercase di/ke/dari/dan/yang/untuk/dengan/atau/oleh/sebagai/dalam; sentences and tooltips use sentence case. Plurals: Indonesian has a single form, so counted strings are plain. Developer words stay as Indonesian developers write them, and as Vibe GitTree does (branch, build, default, path, regex, hot exit). Baris is both line and row; the context tells them apart. Toasts put the object first with a passive verb (%@ disimpan, %@ disalin).
notes.it: Informal tu, as in Apple's Italian: imperatives for commands (Scegli, Apri, Aggiungi), 'fai clic'. Sentence case everywhere; quotes “ ” and the apostrophe ’ as in macOS Italian. Failures read “Impossibile …” (Couldn’t, Can’t); status messages are participles (Copiato, Salvato, Ricaricato); the status bar shortens line and column to “Rg” and “Col”.
notes.ja: Polite です/ます in sentences; dictionary form or a noun phrase for buttons, menu items and tooltips (コピー, 開く…); a final 。 only where the English has a final period. macOS wording: ウインドウ, フォルダ, 設定, キャンセル, ターミナル, キーチェーン, アップデート, システム設定. Names in 「」; ASCII ': ' after labels; full-width （） around Japanese text, ASCII () around shortcuts like (⌘G). No spaces between Japanese and placeholders. Pin is 固定 and reopen is 開き直す; table rows and text lines are both 行, a CSV column's letter goes before 列 (B列), a numbered untitled name keeps macOS's space (名称未設定 2), and parentheses in running text are full-width （） even around Latin text (as in Vibe GitTree) with 「」 around menu paths.
notes.ko: Polite formal register as in Apple's Korean software: statements end in -습니다, instructions in -하세요, short labels, menu items and tooltips are noun phrases or -하기 (복사, 열기, 보기). Placeholders never take a 받침-dependent particle (은/는, 이/가, 을/를, 와/과, 으로/로): put a fixed noun after them (%@ 브랜치가, %@ 커밋이, %@ 프로젝트의) or use 에, 에서, 의, 보다, 만, or a colon. Counts: noun then number with 개 (커밋 %lld개, 티켓 %lld개), 명 for people; Korean has no plural forms, so plain strings. Quotes: curly double quotes. Window is 윈도우 and Terminal 터미널, Finder stays Finder, System Settings is 시스템 설정, Applications is 응용 프로그램, keychain is 키체인, toolbar is 도구 막대. Toasts for a finished action are short status phrases (복사됨, 저장됨, 다시 불러옴), and a parenthetical after Korean text has no space before it (닫기(⌘W), 탭(너비 2)), as in Vibe GitTree.
notes.ms: Malay (Malaysia), formal-neutral register: 'anda' for you, as in Apple's Malay. Menus, buttons and titles use Title Case with lower-case function words (dan, dalam, di, ke, pada, untuk, daripada, dengan, yang, oleh, sebagai), like macOS's Malay; sentences and tooltips use sentence case. 'regular expression' stays English. Quotes are “ ”. Imperatives follow Apple's Malay (Tunjukkan, Sembunyikan, Gunakan, Masukkan) and 'un-' is nyah- (Nyahpinkan, Nyahkod, Nyahdayakan); toasts are short passives with the subject first (Laluan disalin, %@ disimpan); 'baris' is both line and row, and the status bar spells out Baris and Lajur; app, tab, space and folder stay close to English, as in Apple's Malay.
notes.nl: Informal je/jouw, as Apple's Dutch software does. Quotation marks are curly double quotes. Commands, buttons and menu items are imperatives as in Apple's Dutch (Bewaar, Sluit tabblad, Toon in Finder), where save is bewaren and the File menu is Archief; the Applications folder is Apps, as macOS now names it.
notes.pl: Apple's Polish style: imperative 2nd person singular for actions (Wybierz, Dodaj, Sprawdź), sentence case for buttons, menus and titles, quoted names in „ ” (U+201E/U+201D). macOS words: Ustawienia, Ustawienia systemowe, Zachowaj (Save), Anuluj, Gotowe, Usuń, Pokaż w Finderze, Otwórz w Terminalu, pasek boczny, pęk kluczy, folder Programy, E-mail. Counts needing a noun use one/few/many forms; where a count phrase is inserted with %@ it is nominative, so wording avoids a preposition right before it (e.g. '8 zgłoszeń, w tym 5 gotowych'). A name of another part of the app is used with its exact translation (often in quotes). Toasts and statuses use the impersonal past (Skopiowano, Zachowano, Wczytano ponownie); settings toggles use the imperfective imperative (Pokazuj, Wyróżniaj) and commands the perfective (Pokaż, Ukryj). A no-break space (U+00A0) follows single-letter words (w, z, i, a, o) in long sentences, as in Apple's Polish, but not in labels or command names, which the palette searches.
notes.pt-BR: Address the user as 'você' (imperative: Escolha, Selecione, Instale); menu items, buttons and tooltips use the infinitive (Copiar, Mostrar, Abrir), progress lines the gerund (Carregando…). Sentence case (only the first word and proper names capitalized), as the brief asks, although Apple's own macOS pt-BR menus use Title Case. Apple's pt-BR words win over VS Code's (Buscar, not Localizar); the app is masculine (“o Vibe Notepad”) and “app”, not “aplicativo”, except the Aplicativos folder; toasts that name a file or path put it after a colon (“Salvo: README.md”); CSV separator names keep a capital initial because they also stand alone as labels.
notes.ru: Formal «вы»: polite plural imperatives in sentences (Выберите…), infinitives on menu items, buttons and tooltips (Показать…). Sentence case, « » quotes, ё is written (удалённый, отсоединён). macOS names: Finder, Терминал, Системные настройки, Связка ключей, Программы, боковое меню, панель инструментов. Switches in Settings take the imperfective infinitive (Показывать…, Подсвечивать…), menu items and buttons the perfective (Показать…); names that only label Edit → Undo are nouns (Дублирование). A noun after a number that a placeholder fills in can't agree with it, so units are abbreviated (пикс., пт, симв.) and no count phrase follows «из» (it would need the genitive: «500 (всего 2 000 столбцов)»).
notes.th: Neutral polite register (no ครับ/ค่ะ, almost no คุณ), like Apple's Thai UI. No full stop at the end of a sentence and no question mark (questions end in หรือไม่); sentences inside one string are separated by a space. ไม้ยมก is attached (อื่นๆ). A space separates Thai text from numbers and %@ placeholders. A document tab is แถบ as in macOS's ปิดแถบ, but the tab character and the Tab key are แท็บ and Tab; Open Anyway and Save Anyway use macOS's ยืนยันจะเปิด and ยืนยันจะบันทึก; another part of the app named in a sentence goes in “ ” (ใน “ทั่วไป”).
notes.tr: Formal siz-form as in Apple's Turkish: bare imperative on buttons, menu items and tooltips (Kopyala, Aç), polite plural imperative in sentences (seçin, yükleyin). Title Case in menus, buttons and titles as macOS Turkish does; sentence case elsewhere. Never put a suffix on a placeholder (its ending is unknown): use a free word after it (üzerinde, tarafından, ile, sonra). Release notes: Sürüm Notları. A noun stays singular after a number (3 satır) and of between numbers is a slash (3 / 12); ve, ile and için stay lowercase in Title Case; Don't X is the negative imperative (Kaydetme); kept English names take suffixes after ’ by pronunciation, or a free noun avoids it (SVG dosyası, Vibe Notepad uygulaması).
notes.uk: Polite plural "ви" (imperative: Виберіть, Установіть; infinitives on buttons and menus: Скасувати, Скопіювати, Показати у Finder). macOS words: Параметри (Settings), Параметри системи (System Settings), Термінал, Finder, зв’язка ключів, Програми. Sentence case; « » around quoted names; typographic apostrophe ’ (об’єкт); toasts and states are impersonal participles (Скопійовано, Збережено); у- spellings (установити, угору); where Ukrainian macOS has a word, use it (Перегляд for the View menu, Пошук, Наблизити, Віддалити, Реальний розмір), so a preview is попередній перегляд.
notes.vi: Sentence case (only the first word capitalized), as in macOS's Vietnamese; the user is "bạn" (informal-neutral, like Apple), with "Hãy" for instructions. Developer terms that Vietnamese developers say in English stay (tab, regex, hot exit, agent); Cài đặt serves both Settings and Install, as in Vibe GitTree; the case labels UPPERCASE and lowercase show their own case (CHỮ HOA, chữ thường).
notes.zh-Hans: Informal 你, as in Apple's Chinese. Mac words as macOS says them: 拷贝 (Copy), 保存 (Save, as current macOS says it), 好 (OK), 点按 (click), 边栏 (sidebar), 访达 (Finder), 终端 (Terminal), 钥匙串 (keychain), 载入/重新载入 (load/Reload), 应用程序 (Applications); app names in sentences get “ ” quotes. A space between Chinese and Latin letters or digits, full-width punctuation, “ ” around names. Chinese has only the plural category 'other': plain strings, a measure word after numbers (个, 位 for people). Editor words follow VS Code's Chinese where Apple has none (折叠, 缩略图, 自动换行, 区分大小写) and Apple's where it does (前往 Go, 拖移 drag, 选取 choose, 复制 Duplicate vs 拷贝 Copy, 应用程序 for apps). Shortcut hints and asides take full-width parentheses without a space, 关闭（⌘W）; 置顶 is pin, as in Vibe GitTree; 行 is both line and row, and a count goes before it with a space (3 行, 12 列).
notes.zh-Hant: Traditional Chinese as used in Taiwan, Apple's macOS wording (拷貝, 打開, 按一下, 檔案夾, 鑰匙圈, 終端機, 好 for OK). Informal 你, never 您. Full-width punctuation (，。：；？！（）、), 「」 for quotation marks and for names of other parts of the app, a space between Chinese and Latin letters or digits (「在 Finder 中顯示」, 「%lld 個提交」). Counts take 個 (位 for people), no plural forms. Taiwan table words: row 列, column 欄 (also for the caret, 「行 12，欄 5」), a line of text 行. Shortcuts stay in half-width parentheses after a space (「關閉 (⌘W)」); parentheses around Chinese words or values are full-width (「縮排（2）」).
